s.en: Download missing objects in a partial clone

o.en: Specify a minimum size for a batch of missing objects to request from the server. This size may be exceeded by the last set of blobs seen at a given path. The default minimum batch size is 50,000.
Only download objects if they appear at a path that matches the current sparse-checkout. If the sparse-checkout feature is enabled, then --sparse is assumed and can be disabled with --no-sparse.
